Summary of Changes for shared_theta_gamma Implementation

Source: CHANGES_SUMMARY.md

Overview

Added the shared_theta_gamma parameter to the spacetime model that allows sharing the same theta_gamma parameter for both x and y components across all time nodes.

Changes Made

1. R/complex-models.R

Function Documentation

  • Added @param shared_theta_gamma TRUE if share the same theta_gamma for all time nodes. (theta_gamma_x and theta_gamma_y will be the same) to the documentation

Parameter Handling

  • Modified theta_K construction to handle three cases:
    • fix_gamma = TRUE: Only cc and kappa parameters
    • shared_theta_gamma = TRUE: cc, kappa, and single theta_gamma parameter
    • Default: cc, kappa, theta_gamma_x, and theta_gamma_y parameters
  • Updated n_theta_gamma_y calculation to be 0 when shared_theta_gamma = TRUE

Gamma Computation

  • Added conditional logic to use theta_gamma_x for both x and y components when shared_theta_gamma = TRUE
  • Modified gamma_x_list and gamma_y_list computation accordingly

Update Function

  • Modified the update_K function to handle parameter extraction for the shared case
  • When shared_theta_gamma = TRUE, theta_gamma_y is set equal to theta_gamma_x

Parameter Names and Transformations

  • Updated param_name to show “theta_gamma” instead of separate x and y parameters when shared
  • Updated param_trans to use single identity transformation when shared

Validation

  • Added validation to warn users if they provide different values for theta_gamma_x and theta_gamma_y when shared_theta_gamma = TRUE
  • Added validation to ensure B_gamma_x and B_gamma_y have the same number of columns when shared
  • Added validation for B_gamma_x_list and B_gamma_y_list to ensure consistent column counts when shared

ngme_operator Call

  • Added shared_theta_gamma parameter to the ngme_operator call

2. src/operator.h

Class Declaration

  • Added shared_theta_gamma as a private boolean member variable to the Spacetime class

3. src/latents/tensorprod.cpp

Constructor

  • Added initialization of shared_theta_gamma from the operator_list in the Spacetime constructor

update_K Function

  • Modified parameter extraction logic to handle the shared case:
    • When shared_theta_gamma = TRUE, only extract theta_gamma_x and set theta_gamma_y = theta_gamma_x
    • When shared_theta_gamma = FALSE, extract both parameters separately as before

Usage Examples

Before (separate parameters):

model <- spacetime(
  mesh = mesh,
  fix_gamma = FALSE,
  theta_gamma_x = c(0.1),
  theta_gamma_y = c(0.2)
)
# Results in 4 parameters: cc, kappa, theta_gamma_x, theta_gamma_y

After (shared parameter):

model <- spacetime(
  mesh = mesh,
  fix_gamma = FALSE,
  shared_theta_gamma = TRUE,
  theta_gamma_x = c(0.1)
)
# Results in 3 parameters: cc, kappa, theta_gamma
# Both x and y components use the same theta_gamma_x value

Benefits

  1. Reduced parameter space: When the advection is isotropic or when x and y components should be the same, this reduces the number of parameters to estimate
  2. Improved identifiability: In cases where separate x and y parameters are not identifiable, sharing them can improve model stability
  3. Backward compatibility: The default behavior (shared_theta_gamma = FALSE) maintains existing functionality

Testing

Created test_shared_theta_gamma.R to verify the implementation works correctly for all three cases: 1. shared_theta_gamma = FALSE (default) 2. shared_theta_gamma = TRUE (new functionality) 3. fix_gamma = TRUE (should ignore shared_theta_gamma)
